scope: Add the smallest framework-neutral ASGI response-body encoding boundary so the create-customer ASGI callable can send response body bytes, preserving existing internal ASGI-profile behavior. Still not a Python ASGI app and no Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Django selection/import.

change.added: optional encodeResponseBody parameter on AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.call and .callFromReceive, plus a default JSON response body encoder wired into createCustomerAsgiComposition.app
behavior: call({ scope, body, send, encodeResponseBody }) and callFromReceive({ ..., encodeResponseBody }) accept an optional encoder function
when encodeResponseBody is omitted, call/callFromReceive/handle behavior and the internal profile event body shape (a JS object) are unchanged

when encodeResponseBody is supplied, it is applied to every http.response.body event's body before send/return, including the deterministic 400 profile events raised on invalid scope, malformed receive events, and decodeBody throw
encodeResponseBody is validated as a function when supplied (TypeError otherwise, no send/router invocation); an encoder throw propagates and is not caught

createCustomerAsgiComposition.app now passes both the existing JSON request decoder and a new JSON response encoder (JSON.stringify + UTF-8 bytes) to asgi.callFromReceive, so host-adapter callers receive Uint8Array response body chunks
asgi.call/asgi.router/close direct-call behavior (no encoder) is unchanged

targeted: call without encodeResponseBody preserves existing object response body
call with encodeResponseBody converts the success response body to Uint8Array and returns the same sent events
call with encodeResponseBody applies to invalid-scope 400 profile events
callFromReceive with encodeResponseBody applies to decode-error 400 profile events
encodeResponseBody throw propagates and is not swallowed
call rejects a non-function encodeResponseBody without invoking send
app(scope, receive, send) response body is Uint8Array decoding to the expected JSON error envelope for the invariant-violation and invalid-JSON profile cases
all existing kernel-asgi-core-profile and kernel-create-customer-asgi-composition tests remain green
